title: One Man vs. an Entire SEAL Team. #movie #film #crime #action #military #shorts
description:
The Terminal List Season 1 (2022)
Tell the story of a SEAL team that gets ambushed during a high-risk covert mission. Reese returns home with conflicting memories of that mission and lingering doubts about his own culpability. However, as new evidence comes to light, Reese discovers dark forces working against him.
